nodes.name: Deployment
nodes.summary: Kubernetes Deployment manifest for the HipCortex container. Configures replica count, image, port 3030, environment variables (including PORT and DATA_DIR), optional secret-backed API key injection via secretKeyRef, a persistent or emptyDir data volume mount, and liveness/readiness probes.

nodes.name: PersistentVolumeClaim
nodes.summary: Conditionally rendered PersistentVolumeClaim (only when persistence.enabled is true). Requests storage with a configurable access mode, size, and optional storageClass from Helm values. Named with the fullname helper suffixed by -data.

nodes.name: Secret
nodes.summary: Conditionally rendered Opaque Kubernetes Secret (only when apiKeys value is set). Stores base64-encoded API keys under the key api-keys, which the Deployment references via secretKeyRef for the HIPCORTEX_API_KEYS environment variable.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Kubernetes Service that exposes the HipCortex Deployment. Configurable service type (ClusterIP/NodePort/LoadBalancer) and port via Helm values, with targetPort fixed at 3030 to match the container. Uses selectorLabels to bind to the Deployment pods.

edges.description: Deployment mounts the PVC (claimName: fullname-data) as the data volume when persistence.enabled is true
Deployment reads the Secret via secretKeyRef for the HIPCORTEX_API_KEYS environment variable when apiKeys is set
Service selects Deployment pods via shared selectorLabels and routes traffic to container port 3030
